analysis_md: 两边取对数得，$\ln z=y^x\ln x$，两边关于 $x$ 求导得，$\frac{1}{z}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=y^x\ln y\ln x+y^x\frac{1}{x}$，则 $$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=x^{y^x}y^x(\ln y\ln x+\frac{1}{x})$$
